description: Read one inbound email by id: from, to, subject, preheader, body_text and attachments, each with the part_index getEmailAttachment takes. body_text leaves out quoted history and shows each link as an [n] marker; link_count counts them and the links argument returns their targets. When body_next_offset is not null, call again with offset set to it. If parse_status is pending or processing, read it again shortly; failed means the body may be incomplete. full: true adds body_html, parsed, auth and replies. Result: the email is in data.data.

api_key.description: Your API key from createEmailAddress, used in place of sign-in.

full.description: Return the stored record, with the HTML body, links, quoted history and authentication results, instead of the compact view for reading.

id.description: Inbound email ID from listEmails or searchEmails.

links.description: Link targets to include in `links`: all of them, or the [n] numbers you want. Leave it out for none. Not used with full.

max_chars.description: How much of body_text to return per call; read the rest with offset. Not used with full.

offset.description: Character position in the body to start from: the body_next_offset of the previous result. Not used with full.

name: getEmail

outputSchema.description: Envelope; the result is in data.data.

auth.description: Full only: SPF, DKIM, DMARC results.

body_incomplete.description: HTML too deep to read in full.

body_next_offset.description: Next offset; null at the end.

body_source.description: html, text or none: what body_text came from.

links.description: Targets the links argument asked for.

parse_status.description: pending or processing: read again shortly.

title: Get email
